topic: What antenna designs balance aerodynamic constraints with MIMO requirements for high-speed aircraft communication?
consensus_response: Conformal antennas with phased arrays and beamforming optimize aerodynamics and MIMO performance. Polarization diversity enhances signal reliability, while frequency-selective surfaces reduce interference. Metamaterial-based FSS tailors frequency responses, improving SINR and system capacity.
reference_context: Mission requirements impose constraints on antenna design, including angular exploration margin and space environment considerations.
